source_notice.subject: Addition to the BSE SME IPO INDEX
source_notice.repaired_parser_shape: two explicit Notice No / issuer / Exchange ticker references joined by '&', followed by shared 'listed on SME platform of BSE effective ...' listing statement

safety_rules: September 12, 2025 is the shared listing date from the issuer-listing statement.
September 15, 2025 is an index-admission effective date and is not used as the listing date.
Both issuer references must independently provide a listing notice number and six-digit BSE ticker.
Index evidence is discovery-only; issuer-specific official BSE listing notices are required before materialization.
